model_annotation:
The figure presents two line plots comparing training rewards over steps for different models on easy and hard training sets. The top plot, labeled "Easy Training Set," displays training rewards on the y-axis (ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 with linear scale and tick marks every 0.1) against steps on the x-axis (ranging from 0 to 500 with linear scale and tick marks every 100). Two lines are shown: a teal line with circular markers representing "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and a red line with circular markers representing "Llama-LUFFY-Easy." Both lines start near 0.0 at step 0 and increase steadily, with the red line consistently slightly above the teal line; by step 500, the red line reaches approximately 0.4, while the teal line reaches about 0.35. Both lines are accompanied by shaded regions indicating uncertainty or confidence intervals.

The bottom plot, labeled "Hard Training Set," shares the same x-axis (steps from 0 to 500, linear, tick marks every 100) and y-axis (training rewards from 0.0 to 0.2, linear, tick marks every 0.05). It features two lines: a teal line with circular markers for "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" and a red line with circular markers for "Llama-LUFFY-Hard." The teal line starts near 0.0, rises slightly to about 0.03 around step 50, then drops sharply to near 0.0 by step 100 and remains flat thereafter. The red line starts near 0.0, increases gradually to about 0.1 by step 100, continues to rise with fluctuations, and reaches approximately 0.2 by step 500. The red line is also accompanied by a shaded region indicating uncertainty, while the teal line has no visible shaded region.
